description_en: Creates a rate limiting rule for a quality of service (QoS) policy by calling the CreateQosCar operation
description_zh: 调用CreateQosCar接口创建QoS的限速规则
kebab_example: aliyun smartag create-qos-car --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --qos-id qos-xitd8690ucu8ro0000 --priority 2 --limit-type Absolute --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateQosCar

parameters.help_en: The description of the QoS rate limiting rule
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the QoS policy instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
QoS策略实例所在的地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html接口查询地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the QoS policy
parameters.name: qos_id

parameters.help_en:
The priority of the rate limiting rule. 

Valid values: 1 to 3. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. If two rules have the same priority, the rule that is created first takes effect
parameters.help_zh:
设置限速规则的优先级。 

取值范围：1~3。数值越小，优先级越高。同优先级时先下发的规则优先生效
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en:
The type of rate limiting. Valid values:

Absolute: by bandwidth value.

Percent: by percentage
parameters.help_zh:
限速类型，取值：

Absolute：按带宽值。

Percent：按百分比
parameters.name: limit_type

parameters.help_en:
The minimum bandwidth value. The value must be an integer. Unit: Mbit/s.

This parameter is required when LimitType is set to Absolute
parameters.help_zh:
最小带宽值，带宽值需要输入整数，单位：Mbps。

LimitType是Absolute时必填
parameters.name: min_bandwidth_abs

parameters.help_en:
The maximum bandwidth value. The value must be an integer. Unit: Mbit/s.

This parameter is required when LimitType is set to Absolute.

The maximum bandwidth value must be greater than the minimum bandwidth value
parameters.help_zh:
最大带宽值，带宽值需要输入整数，单位：Mbps。

LimitType是Absolute时必填。

输入的最大带宽值必须大于最小带宽值
parameters.name: max_bandwidth_abs

parameters.help_en:
The minimum bandwidth percentage. Unit: percent (%). Valid values: 1 to 100.

This parameter is required when LimitType is set to Percent
parameters.help_zh:
最小带宽百分比，单位：百分比（%），取值范围：1~100。

LimitType是Percent时必填
parameters.name: min_bandwidth_percent

parameters.help_en:
The maximum bandwidth percentage. Unit: percent (%). Valid values: 1 to 100.

This parameter is required when LimitType is set to Percent.

The maximum bandwidth percentage must be greater than the minimum bandwidth percentage
parameters.help_zh:
最大带宽百分比，单位：百分比（%），取值范围：1~100。

LimitType是Percent时必填。

输入的最大带宽百分比必须大于最小带宽百分比
parameters.name: max_bandwidth_percent

parameters.help_en:
The bandwidth type when rate limiting by percentage. Valid values:

CcnBandwidth: CCN bandwidth.

InternetUpBandwidth: total Internet bandwidth
parameters.help_zh:
百分比限速时的带宽类型，取值：

CcnBandwidth：表示CCN带宽。

InternetUpBandwidth：表示Internet总带宽
parameters.name: percent_source_type

parameters.help_en:
The name of the QoS rate limiting rule.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
QoS限速规则名称。

长度为2~128，以字母或中文开头，且只包含中文、字母、数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: name
